method.value: A non-technical CEO spent 24 hours building an app in Replit to test whether his 50-person company should go all-in. He says the agent was highly productive at first, adding needed pieces without being asked, but later they fell into a whack-a-mole cycle where fixing one bug broke another; his takeaways were to work in planned chunks, keep the build modular, and use self-testing checklists.

outcome.value: He came away impressed enough to use Replit for side projects and to teach a beginner course internally, but not to rebuild the company’s core stack. The main failure was reliability on larger, changing projects, where working features started breaking and iteration became frustrating.

notes.value: His main catch was control and risk: after the trial, he decided using it to replace working infrastructure created too much unnecessary risk.

source_text.body:
Build an app in a day, then hit bug loops
The author built an app with Replit in 24 hours. The agent was productive at first, then got stuck fixing one bug while breaking another.
·
May 25, 2025
Done with
RA
Replit Agent
What they did
A non-technical CEO spent 24 hours building an app in Replit to test whether his 50-person company should go all-in. He says the agent was highly productive at first, adding needed pieces without being asked, but later they fell into a whack-a-mole cycle where fixing one bug broke another; his takeaways were to work in planned chunks, keep the build modular, and use self-testing checklists.
How it went
He came away impressed enough to use Replit for side projects and to teach a beginner course internally, but not to rebuild the company’s core stack. The main failure was reliability on larger, changing projects, where working features started breaking and iteration became frustrating.
Worth knowing
His main catch was control and risk: after the trial, he decided using it to replace working infrastructure created too much unnecessary risk.
Try it yourself
with
Replit Agent
Copy prompt
Here is a bug in my app: [describe the bug and how to reproduce it]. Fix only this bug without changing unrelated features, then test that it's fixed and that [list of working features] still work. If the fix doesn't work after two attempts, stop, explain what you've tried, and ask me how to proceed.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/replit/comments/1kv4ueg/lessons_from_24_hours_obsessed_with_replit
